checks.name: Packed package contains only the public SDK
Clean consumer imports the exact public exports
Published declarations typecheck in a clean consumer
Quote roundtrip sends the exact request without credentials
Buy builds local calldata and reaches the wallet boundary
Sell uses zero value and never approves implicitly
Approval targets the token and authorizes only the exact amount
Mint builds a factory launch with Arweave metadata and zero value
Mint receipt parsing ignores another factory
Invalid inputs fail before HTTP or wallet submission
Wrong wallet chain fails before requesting a quote
Tampered token cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered side cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered chainId cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered amount cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered minimumOut cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered fee cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered amountOut cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered slippageBps cannot reach wallet signing
Tampered issuedAt cannot reach wallet signing
Malformed and expired responses are rejected
Rate limit errors preserve status and Retry-After
Aborting a quote preserves cancellation
Wallet rejection passes through without a second submission
Every built docs route renders and all local links resolve
Docs use the Floor1 purple brand tokens
Search opens by keyboard and navigates to minting
Code and page copy controls write real clipboard content
Light theme persists after navigation
Controls and surfaces use cut corners in both themes
Mobile navigation opens and every route avoids page overflow
Markdown exports and llms.txt are available
Every page has distinct search metadata, structured data and a matching sitemap

coverage: Packed consumer → quote HTTP → decoded wallet submission boundary, mint receipt parsing, built documentation browser journeys. No real chain transactions.
reproduce: npm ci && npx playwright install chromium && npm run e2e
